attributes.title: Sigma 49th Biennial Convention
attributes.organizer: Sigma Theta Tau International Honor Society of Nursing
attributes.summary:
Sigma Theta Tau International Honor Society of Nursing holds its 49th Biennial Convention from October 29 to November 1, 2027, in Denver, Colorado. The convention meets every two years and mixes nursing research, leadership and education sessions with the society's governance business and awards.

Sigma asks presenters to submit abstracts by December 11. Registration, hotel information, the venue and the contact hours on offer will be published closer to the event, according to the convention page.
